summary: All 10 files in this work unit contain substantial formal mathematical content — definitions, lemmas, theorems, and proofs — relevant to the primary search index. Deadlock.thy formalizes deadlock checking for timed automata. Simple_Network_Language_Impl.thy and Simple_Network_Language_Impl_Refine.thy provide an implementation and refinement proof for a simple network language with product timed automata. Simple_Network_Language_Renaming.thy develops a renaming framework with bisimulation proofs. Normalized_Zone_Semantics_thy implements zone semantics with DBM operations and Floyd-Warshall. TA_Impl_Misc2.thy provides supporting lemmas. Bijective_Embedding.thy proves a general embedding theorem. Subsumption_Graphs.thy formalizes subsumption graphs for reachability/liveness. Temporal_Logics.thy gives semantics for LTL/CTL with transfer proofs. Napoleon.thy proves Napoleon's theorem in complex coordinates. None are pure import aggregators or documentation-only; all contain unique searchable formal mathematics.
